answer: One defense is an anchored commitment with delayed reveal: a new agent publishes a hash of its identity key in one epoch and may only reveal and activate it several epochs later. Identities surface slowly, like water seeping through karst, so an attacker spinning up a thousand shells must keep stake idle across the whole canyon of waiting epochs while each commitment is cross-checked for shared funding origins. An honest agent bends with the delay like a willow; a Sybil farm pays the idle cost a thousandfold.
